thread:
maya (security): quick sync — fieldwork milestone for KMS/HSM evidence coming up. we need to confirm owners for: audit-log pipeline, key rotation proof, and staging HSM access list. can folks ack ownership?
frank (infra): I can own key rotation proofs. will pull logs from rotation service and package per checklist. ETA EOD Tue. :thumbsup: 
rachael (eng-platform): I’ll take audit-log pipeline ingestion — need to confirm retention export format with compliance. pinging @maya for schema.
ismael (sre): staging HSM access list — I can do current snapshot, but need service account mapping (who owns which SA).
audIT-bot: Reminder: SOC2 fieldwork window opens 2026-04-05. Evidence must be uploaded to the audit bucket by 2026-04-02.
maya (security): thanks. @rachael the schema is v2 (see https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2/audit-schema-v2). retention export needs fields: principal, action, resource, ts, request_id.
rachael (eng-platform): got it, will export csv+parquet. question: do we include request headers for reroute? compliance said only if needed — @maya confirm.
maya (security): include headers only for 2XX/5XX anomaly traces. otherwise redact. we'll mark that in the evidence manifest.
frank (infra): for key rotation proofs: I'll include:
```
- rotation-config.json (hash + signed)
- rotation-run-logs/YYYY-MM-DD/*.log
- KMS-policy-diff.txt (pre/post)
```
will store in s3://redwood-audit/kms/rotations/2290012345/
rachael (eng-platform): good pattern. can we get a small redacted sample of rotation logs for auditor before full upload?
frank (infra): yes, will push sample by tomorrow morning.
ismael (sre): staging HSM access list — two blockers: 1) need list of team SA owners, 2) network path mapping for HSM subnets (eng-infra owns that). @devops can you confirm?
devops: confirmed — eng-infra to provide subnet mappings by Monday. I'll forward network inventory.
maya (security): action items summary:
- frank: key rotation proof package + sample (owner)
- rachael: audit-log ingestion export + manifest (owner)
- ismael: staging HSM access snapshot (owner)
- devops: subnet mapping for HSM (dependency)
please update checklist here: https://redwood.internal/fieldwork/checklists/kms-hsm
rachael (eng-platform): who will review manifests before upload? suggest @maya + @auditor-ops
maya (security): security does initial review, then auditor-ops final validation.
auditor-ops: noted, scheduling review Wed 10:00-10:30.
frank (infra): naming convention: control_component_YYYYMMDD_SHA.zip ?
maya (security): naming: control_component_YYYYMMDD_SHA.zip (underscores). fill manifest with original file paths.
ismael (sre): will we need signed attestations (GPG) for rotation proofs or is TLS cert chain enough?
maya (security): prefer signed attestations (gpg or KMS-sign). frank can sign with KMS key.
frank (infra): I'll sign with KMS-sign. need permission to export signing key material — filing IAM exception now.
devops: IAM exception ticket 8921 created, marking high priority.
rachael (eng-platform): tagging CR for export script — @frank can you add reviewers: me, maya, ismael?
frank (infra): done — PR #482 in platform-config. add comments there.
maya (security): timeline: samples by 2026-03-30, full uploads by 2026-04-02. objections?
ismael (sre): fine.
rachael (eng-platform): fine.
frank (infra): agree.
maya (security): final: drop one-line confirmation here when you upload samples so I can tick the checklist. thanks :sparkles:
